description: Structured Form I-9 — Employment Eligibility Verification. Tracks Section 1 (employee), Section 2 (employer verification), Section 3 / Supplement B (reverification and rehire), receipts, retention dates, and destruction. Every action is logged to I-9 Audit Log.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Section 1 Complete
Awaiting Verification
Complete
Reverification Needed
Expired
Destroyed

fields.description: Only the last four digits. Everything that prints an SSN on this site prints XXX-XX-1234 off this column, and it is written whether or not the full number is stored beside it.
fields.label: SSN (Last 4)

fields.description: The full nine digits, encrypted at rest in Frappe's own password table — WRITTEN ONLY WHERE I-9 Settings has 'Store Full SSN' switched on, and blanked on save the moment that switch goes off. E-Verify submits the whole number and cannot be run from the last four, which is the only reason this column exists. No tool reads it back: get_i9_form does not return it, and nothing in this app prints it.
fields.label: SSN (Full, Encrypted)
Citizenship Status
fields.options:
US Citizen
Noncitizen National
Lawful Permanent Resident
Alien Authorized to Work

fields.depends_on: eval:['Lawful Permanent Resident','Alien Authorized to Work'].includes(doc.citizenship_status)
fields.description: A Lawful Permanent Resident gives this one. An Alien Authorized to Work gives THIS or the I-94 number or the foreign passport pair below — Section 1 asks for one of the three, not all of them.
fields.label: Alien Registration / USCIS Number

fields.description: Form I-94 / I-94A Arrival-Departure Record number. The second of the three identifiers an Alien Authorized to Work may give in Section 1.
fields.label: Form I-94 Admission Number

fields.description: The third identifier, and it is a PAIR: a foreign passport number means nothing without the country that issued it, and Section 1 asks for both together.
fields.label: Foreign Passport Number

fields.description: When the authorization runs out. Reverification moves this forward to the new document's date, so it always names the document currently in force.
fields.label: Work Authorization Expiry

fields.description: Where the handset said it was when the attestation was made, as "latitude,longitude". Filled by whichever path carried the signature: the section submit, the signature pad, or attach_signed_i9 for an I-9 built and signed on the phone. Corroboration, not verification — the server cannot check it. Blank means no fix was reported.
fields.label: Section 1 Signed GPS

fields.description: What was examined was a RECEIPT for a lost, stolen or damaged document rather than the document itself. Acceptable under 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(vi) for 90 days from the hire date, after which the actual document must be recorded through reverify_i9.
fields.label: List A Document Is a Receipt

fields.description: Photograph or scan of the List A document that was examined, filed by the app as it is captured and attached to the Employee record. This column references it so the copy is produced WITH the form, as 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(3) requires of an employer who keeps copies.
fields.label: List A Document Copy

fields.description: What was examined was a receipt for a lost, stolen or damaged identity document. Same 90-day window as List A.
fields.label: List B Document Is a Receipt

fields.description: Photograph or scan of the List B (identity) document that was examined, filed by the app as it is captured and attached to the Employee record. This column references it so the copy is produced WITH the form, as 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(3) requires of an employer who keeps copies.
fields.label: List B Document Copy

fields.description: What was examined was a receipt for a lost, stolen or damaged employment authorization document. Same 90-day window as List A.
fields.label: List C Document Is a Receipt

fields.description: Photograph or scan of the List C (employment authorization) document that was examined, filed by the app as it is captured and attached to the Employee record. This column references it so the copy is produced WITH the form, as 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(3) requires of an employer who keeps copies.
fields.label: List C Document Copy

fields.description: Set on save whenever any examined document above is a receipt, and cleared when reverify_i9 records the document it stood in for. THE FORM IS STILL Complete while this is ticked — a receipt is temporarily acceptable and the person may work — so this column rather than the status is what carries the outstanding obligation. list_pending_i9_verifications reports the ones running out.
fields.label: Receipt Pending

fields.description: Auto-calculated: hire_date + 90 days. The last day a receipt stands in for the document it replaces.
fields.label: Receipt Valid Until

fields.description: Where the handset said it was when the verifier certified the documents, as "latitude,longitude". Filled by whichever path carried the signature, including attach_signed_i9 for an I-9 built and signed on the phone. Corroboration, not verification. Blank means no fix was reported.
fields.label: Section 2 Signed GPS

fields.description: Form I-9's Supplement B. Every reverification and every rehire recorded against this form, oldest first — the ones ABOVE this line record the day of hire and are never overwritten by one of these.
fields.label: Section 3 — Reverification and Rehire

fields.description: The USCIS Form I-9 filled from this record by render_i9_pdf. Regenerate it with overwrite=true after any edit; it is a snapshot, not a live view.
fields.label: Generated I-9 PDF

fields.description: The signed or scanned copy returned by the employee and the employer. This is the retained federal record; the generated PDF above is the page it was printed from.
fields.label: Signed I-9 PDF

fields.description: Auto-calculated: MAX(hire_date + 3 years, termination_date + 1 year).
fields.label: Retain Until

name: I-9 Form
